class.name: FlowGraphMermaidOptions

members.member: The direction of the flowchart in the header line ([code]flowchart TD[/code], [code]LR[/code], [code]BT[/code] or [code]RL[/code]). Only the rendering depends on it; it is not read back.

If [code]true[/code], data connections are drawn as dotted edges [code]-.->|output:input|[/code]. If [code]false[/code], the diagram shows only the control flow and data connections are kept in [code]%% flow:edge[/code] comment lines (only with [member include_data_comments]).

If [code]true[/code], node types, properties, frames and graph properties are written in [code]%% flow:[/code] comment lines, so the file loads back unchanged. If [code]false[/code], the file is a plain Mermaid diagram; loading it creates generic nodes as for a hand-written flowchart.

If [code]true[/code], [member FlowNode.editor_position], [member FlowNode.editor_size], [member FlowNode.editor_comment], [member FlowFrame.rect] and [member FlowFrame.color] are written. If [code]false[/code], they are left out and reset on load.
